correctness.rationale: For positive definite H with spectrum in the inclusive [mu,L], the joint Gaussian target has an exact outer Y reflection; a conditional mirror or independent Gaussian refresh preserves the conditional X law. Along one eigendirection, the Bernoulli-averaged mean transfer has characteristic z^2-t(2-rho)z+1-rho. Balancing endpoint |t| and repeated roots gives unique affine minimax tuning eta=(mu L)^(-1/2), rho=1-q^2, q=(kappa^(1/4)-1)/(kappa^(1/4)+1), for kappa>1. Unconditional covariance errors evolve via (1-rho)Sym^2(M0)+rho Sym^2(M1), not Sym^2((1-rho)M0+rho M1), with the stated cubic. Its endpoint signs P(q)<0<P(1) guarantee an eigenvalue in (q,1). Positivity of the lifted map and L^2(Sigma)≺Sigma force all quadratic modes below 1, while positive cone comparison and the positive definite position-functional Gram matrix show a legitimate centered Gaussian initial covariance Sigma+epsilon I has position-variance defect of exact root rate r2>q. The kappa=1 all-refresh case is treated separately; no full L2 or TV assertion is made. Independent rational computation reconstructed the cubic at q=1/3, its two signs, and positive variance defects, giving r2≈0.4098522656577.
residual_risks: The check samples one rational endpoint, while the all-parameter conclusion rests on the supplied analytic inequalities and positive-map proof; the spectral statement does not extend to all sampler implementations.

value.rationale: A mathematically meaningful counterexample to the common inference that first-degree spectral optimization controls degree-two relaxation: the two eigenvalue optimizations separate at every nontrivial condition number, and a real position variance displays the slowdown. The result sharply identifies the role of shared Bernoulli switching without pretending to solve global sampler mixing or oracle complexity.
residual_risks: Its interpretation is limited to an ideal exact conditional kernel; practical performance benefits or a full quadratic optimal calibration are unproved.

limitations: Full text of the motivating same-model preprint was inaccessible after lawful attempts; institutional access reported disconnected VPN, a documentary/access risk not a correctness failure.
